tools.name: fetch_url_metadata
tools.description: Fetch a web page and return its metadata as JSON: title, description, canonical URL, favicon, Open Graph tags (og:title, og:image, ...), Twitter card tags, author/keywords/robots/theme-color, word count, HTTP status, response time, and detected tech stack (Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, Vercel, Cloudf

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Create a new ogfetch account with no email or browser required. Returns an API key with free trial credits. Only call this if you do not already have a key; store the returned key, it cannot be shown again.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Return the remaining credit balance and usage for the API key.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: List available one-time credit packs and prices. No API key needed.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Create a Stripe checkout link to top up this API key. Plans: starter = 1000 credits for $3; pro = 5000 credits for $10; business = 15000 credits for $20. Give the returned checkout_url to your user to pay (or complete it if you can make payments). Credits are added automatically after payment.

tools.name: buy_credits_usdc
tools.description: Create a Solana Pay quote to top up this API key with USDC on Solana mainnet. Returns transaction_url, solana_pay_url, amount_usdc and a reference. POST {"account": "<your wallet address>"} to transaction_url to get a ready-to-sign base64 transaction; sign and send it. Or show solana_pay_url as a QR

tools.name: check_usdc_payment
tools.description: Check a buy_credits_usdc quote by its reference. Finds the payment on-chain and adds the credits once. Returns status pending, credited, or expired. Poll every few seconds after paying.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch_url_metadata, buy_credits_usdc · Private data: create_account, get_account, get_pricing, buy_credits, buy_credits_usdc · Public sink: create_account, buy_credits_usdc.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch_url_metadata, buy_credits_usdc · Private data: create_account, get_account, get_pricing, buy_credits, buy_credits_usdc · Public sink: create_account, buy_credits_usdc

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
